_usage: One-off message from the NPC. No branching. Player dismisses when done.
For multiple variants (in order or randomly), create several copies of this file
with suffixes (_1, _2, _3) and let an external function choose which dialog ID
to start based on a scoreboard counter or random value.
/npc edit commands add blabber dialogue start luminacion:<name>_1 --clicker-- @e[...]
Replace <npc_key> in the 'end' action below with this NPC's key from
_maps/npcs/registry.json — it resumes the NPC's routine if it was paused
NPC has a roaming movement mode; otherwise the whole 'action' field can be removed.
